description:
Extendable microfiber car duster is the quick, scratch‑free way to remove dust, pollen, and loose dirt from your car exterior and interior—without dragging a wet cloth across paint. The dense microfiber head traps fine dust so your dashboard, windshield area, bonnet, and roof look clean in minutes. Its stainless steel handle extends from about 28.5" to 34", making it a smart choice for SUVs, trucks, and tall vehicles where roof cleaning is usually a pain.

Use it for daily dry dusting between washes, before a drive, or right before guests hop in. The lightweight, ergonomic grip reduces wrist strain, and the duster head is washable and reusable—so you save money on disposable wipes and keep your car looking freshly detailed. It also works great at home for shelves, windows, and countertops when you want fast, lint‑free cleaning.
